name: POST /api/leadflow/offers - draft a version, unquotable until approved
description:
Drafts a new version of an offer. A DRAFT IS UNQUOTABLE (92ce5959-0e5c-4ce8-be7a-02cc870b2120#AC2): it is created unapproved and inactive, so nothing a rep can read changes until the full route has signed off and somebody activates it. GET /offers/current returns only the active version, so a draft is invisible to the people who quote rather than merely marked.

EVERY COMMERCIAL FIELD SOP §12 REQUIRES IS MANDATORY AT DRAFT TIME (92ce5959-0e5c-4ce8-be7a-02cc870b2120#AC4), not checked later at publish. A half-filled sheet invites the gap to be closed by improvisation on a call, which is the failure the whole Offer Data Sheet exists to prevent - price, quantity basis, payment options, licence limits, implementation expectations, refund and cancellation terms, included features, variable charges and third-party charges. The refusal names exactly which fields are missing.

THE VERSION NUMBER IS ASSIGNED BY THE SERVER as max+1 per offer, not supplied by the caller. A caller-chosen number lets two drafts claim the same version, and afterwards no dispute about "which v3 did they sign" is answerable.

QA: depends on register and login. offer_key is randomised per run so the chain that follows - approve, activate, current, checkout - operates on its own offer rather than fighting a previous run's.

requestBody.license_limits: Five seats included; additional seats billed at the same per-seat rate.
requestBody.implementation_expectations: Kickoff inside five business days; data migration is a separate statement of work.
requestBody.refund_terms: Full refund inside 14 days of first payment; pro-rata thereafter.
requestBody.cancellation_terms: Thirty days written notice before the renewal date.

testCases.name: A complete Offer Data Sheet is drafted, unapproved and inactive

testCases.name: NEGATIVE: a sheet missing refund and cancellation terms

errorCases.message: An Offer Data Sheet missing refund_terms, cancellation_terms cannot be drafted - a rep filling the gap on a call is how two customers end up on different terms
errorCases.when: offer_key is absent, or any commercial field SOP §12 requires is missing, empty or the wrong type.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
